card_en: Short words such as sem, se, mi and bom usually come second: učim se slovenščino, jutri bom doma. Together: sem before se, se before bom, je last: včeraj sem se učil, jutri se bom učil, slabo mi je.

quick_check.explain_en: Se comes before bom: jutri se bom učil, I will study tomorrow.

helper_de: German keeps the verb second; Slovenian keeps the short words second: heute lerne ich, danes se učim.
helper_en: English has nothing like this, so learn the blocks by heart: sem se, se bom, mi je.
